description: Deterministic pre-flight checks on VistaSocial post creation, plus a fixed 60-requests/minute reminder. Prompt hooks only see the tool call, so checks are limited to visible fields.

hooks.prompt:
This PreToolUse prompt hook sees only the tool call JSON ($ARGUMENTS). Check ONLY what is visible in tool_input and return ok=false with a reason if any check fails:

1. TIMEZONE: if publish_at is a concrete datetime, it must carry an explicit UTC offset (e.g. +02:00 or -04:00). A trailing 'Z' or no offset fails. Values 'now', 'queue_next', 'queue_last', 'queue_available' pass.
2. TARGET: profile_id (for create) or publication_id (for update) is present.
3. TAGS: for a new post (no publication_id), tags is a non-empty array (the deprecated labels field also counts).
4. FIRST COMMENT: if message contains http:// or https://, fail with: move the URL into customization.comments (first-comment protocol).
5. CONTENT: a new post has a non-empty message, media_url, media_ids or poll.

Do not fail for anything you cannot see in the tool input (brand SOPs, profile status, rate limits). If every visible check passes, return ok=true.

hooks.command: printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUseFailure","additionalContext":"VistaSocial call failed. If the error mentions 429 or rate limit, pause VistaSocial calls for 60 seconds before one retry; never retry createOrUpdatePost blindly (check listPosts first to avoid duplicate posts)."}}'
